description: Create a new Listing Bureau Amazon project. If a project with the same ASIN+keyword+region was previously archived, it will be reactivated instead (returns 201). ASIN must be a valid Amazon ASIN. Keyword must be 3-200 characters.

expected_retail_price.description: Expected retail price of the product in USD. Required for SFB cost estimation and holds.

region.description: Amazon region code (GB accepted as alias for UK)

name: lb_projects_create
